## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 71% | 0.6% (estimate, low confidence, 0.4–0.7%) | not applicable | 0% |

A small, carefully dated set of 11 consolidated acts: the Constitution, Criminal Code, Criminal Procedure Law and Civil Procedure Law are held as current text with history from 2013-2017, but the Contract Law (Cap. 149), the Civil Procedure Rules and all other legislation are missing, and there is no case law. Three acts (Cap. 148, Cap. 113, Law 52(I)/2022) are current text only, and the official source blocked the wording checks.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
